notes: All source files were read without running their optimization scripts or modifying them.
Time uses 101 uniformly spaced samples and the per-trial CycleTime. Check velocity consistency before simulation.
Normalized forces use each cats recorded weight; moments additionally use its recorded hindlimb length.
EMG values, including missing entries and small negative filtered values, are preserved without normalization or clipping.
The collection names Ted/Brad are dataset labels, not individual animals.
Model 3 has 11 groups. VI is pooled into VL/VM in the source PCSA partition. Other operated muscles may be aggregated or absent; confirm intervention mapping.
